title: menuz uses arca_swift 0.3.0: its own copies go, and one copy runs at a time (issue 0114)
objective: menuz moves to arca_swift 0.3.0, which carries arca_swift issue 0003 (STc203646d7444f4f1 there): the masthead row's two macOS 27 fixes and the XCTest-host check come from arca_swift, and menuz's own copies go. menuz gains arca's single-instance guard: a second launch says that menuz already runs, names that copy's pid, and quits. It ships in 2.15.0, by hv's word "Fix now, in 2.15.0".
